about: Each measure as a ring read against the value of a full turn, the first ring outermost. A ring shows a measure against its own track, such as the use of a quota. A bar chart compares measures with each other.

activity.about: A day's activity against three goals, each ring in a hue palette's chart color through its bar's color.
activity.caption: Standing is at 90% of today's goal, and exercise at 45%.
activity.label: Activity against today's goals
activity.title: Colors

bare.about: track false leaves out each ring's remainder, so a ring reads as a length with nothing to be a share of.
bare.caption: API calls are at 34% of the plan's quota.
bare.title: No track

dial.about: startAngle 225 and endAngle -45 turn each ring three quarters of the way round, clockwise through 12 o'clock, with the gap at the bottom.
dial.caption: Storage is at 82% of the plan's quota.
dial.title: Three quarters of a turn

narrow.about: The plan's usage in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone.
narrow.title: Narrow room

over.about: max 1 fixes a full turn at the quota. Storage at 114% closes its track and the legend writes its value, while seats and API calls keep their share of the quota.
over.caption: Storage is 14% over the plan's quota.
over.title: Past max

quiet.about: A radial bar chart without bars renders the empty state in the plot's place, at the plot's ratio.
quiet.caption: Plan usage this month.
quiet.title: Empty

replay.about: animate grows each ring from its start angle when the chart mounts, and Replay mounts the chart again. Under reduced motion recharts renders the rings at once.
replay.title: Animation

scaled.about: Without max the largest value shown closes its track, so Storage at 82% reads as full and every other ring is measured against it.
scaled.caption: Storage's 82% closes its track, while nothing on the plan is full.
scaled.title: Without max

seats.about: defaultIndex opens the tooltip at a ring when the chart first renders. Its row writes the ring's name and value. The arrows walk the rings from the outermost.
seats.caption: Seats are at 61% of the plan's quota.
seats.title: Tooltip

title: Radial bar chart

usage.about: A plan's use of three quotas. max 1 makes a full turn the whole quota, so each ring reads as a share of its own track, and the legend writes each value beside its name.
usage.caption: Storage is at 82% of the plan's quota, and nothing else is past two thirds.
usage.label: Plan usage
usage.title: Plan usage
